bagPolicy.summary: The venue’s Know Before You Go section allows searched bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, while its prohibited-item list says no large bags over 10 × 10 inches. Because those limits conflict, check the specific show and bring a smaller bag.
allowed: Small bag within both published limits
prohibited: Bags over 10 × 10 inches under prohibited-item list
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The main reserved lot is reached from Alabama Street in front of the marquee, with a North Lot reached from North Street. Reserved passes range from $5–$35 for the main lot or $5–$30 for the North Lot; drive-up rates vary.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue information page does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are offered before concerts; clear empty refillable bottles under 40 ounces are permitted at the second-floor refill station. Outside food and drink are otherwise prohibited.
allowed: Clear empty refillable bottle under 40 ounces
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance and the New Jersey Street Imperial Lounge entrance are accessible. The Egyptian Room accessible section is on the floor near the front, to the right of the stage; accessible parking is limited in the main Alabama Street lot.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Old National Centre venue page does not publish a general re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue uses mobile entry; guests with phone problems can seek help at the event-day box office with ID. It does not describe a universal will-call procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors generally open one hour before showtime. The venue has mobile ticket entry and searches all bags; the main accessible entrance is at the building front.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
